name: Wife of Lot
overview: The Wife of Lot is a female figure in Scripture known primarily for her unique attribute of becoming a pillar of salt, as recorded in Genesis 19:26. Her tribe and additional personal details are not specified in the biblical text. This distinctive event marks her as a significant, though briefly mentioned, character within the narrative.
namesAndTitles: She is referred to simply as the 'Wife of Lot,' a descriptive title meaning 'his wife' as noted in Genesis 19:26. This designation does not provide a personal name but identifies her relational status to Lot.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly identifies her as the wife of Lot, establishing a direct marital relationship. No further family connections or relationships are documented in the biblical record beyond this.
scriptureSignificance: The Wife of Lot's significance lies in her transformation into a pillar of salt, an event that serves as a solemn warning and divine judgment within the biblical narrative. This unique attribute highlights the consequences of disobedience and looking back when God commanded otherwise, emphasizing the holiness and justice of God in the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah.
